Aeluma is a speculative shadow candidate for alternative photonics device manufacturing; survival into later layers requires proof of commercial qualification, revenue materiality, and customer commitments.

BHE is a lower-attention EMS candidate with photonics packaging and test capabilities; materiality to AI transceivers is unproven and requires customer/program verification.
AEHR is not a contract manufacturer but may be a second-order bottleneck supplier if silicon-photonics transceiver reliability and production test capacity becomes scarce.

AEHR is a silicon-photonics test/burn-in shadow candidate; later layers should verify whether announced photonics customers become production-scale revenue.

Need a later pass on sub-$1B or speculative optical-engine/module names such as POET and other photonics packaging suppliers, but they were not included here to keep this pass focused on higher-confidence manufacturing/test chokepoints.
Fabrinet is the primary US-listed reference candidate for neutral optical transceiver contract manufacturing, precision assembly, and test tied to AI data-center 800G/1.6T demand.

Sanmina, Jabil, and Benchmark Electronics should remain in the underfollowed discovery lane until filings or transcripts confirm direct optical, photonics, high-speed datacom, or AI networking manufacturing exposure.
